verses.original: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר לַֽ֭יהוָה הָאָ֣רֶץ וּמְלוֹאָ֑הּ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏā·wiḏ miz·mō·wr Yah·weh hā·’ā·reṣ ū·mə·lō·w·’āh tê·ḇêl wə·yō·šə·ḇê ḇāh
verses.literal: A Psalm of David The earth is the LORD’s and the fullness thereof the world and all who dwell therein

verses.original: כִּי־ ה֭וּא עַל־ יַמִּ֣ים יְסָדָ֑הּ וְעַל־ נְ֝הָר֗וֹת יְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hū ‘al- yam·mîm yə·sā·ḏāh wə·‘al- nə·hā·rō·wṯ yə·ḵō·wn·ne·hā
verses.literal: For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters

verses.original: מִֽי־ יַעֲלֶ֥ה בְהַר־ יְהוָ֑ה וּמִי־ יָ֝קוּם בִּמְק֥וֹם קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mî- ya·‘ă·leh ḇə·har- Yah·weh ū·mî- yā·qūm bim·qō·wm qā·ḏə·šōw
verses.literal: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD Who may stand in His holy place

verses.original: נְקִ֥י כַפַּ֗יִם וּֽבַר־ לֵ֫בָ֥ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר׀ לֹא־ נָשָׂ֣א לַשָּׁ֣וְא נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א נִשְׁבַּ֣ע לְמִרְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: nə·qî ḵap·pa·yim ū·ḇar- lê·ḇāḇ ’ă·šer lō- nā·śā laš·šāw nap̄·šî wə·lō niš·ba‘ lə·mir·māh
verses.literal: He who has clean hands and a pure heart who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully

verses.original: יִשָּׂ֣א בְ֭רָכָה מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה מֵאֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·śā ḇə·rā·ḵāh mê·’êṯ Yah·weh ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh mê·’ĕ·lō·hê yiš·‘ōw
verses.literal: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation

verses.original: זֶ֭ה דּ֣וֹר דֹּרְשׁוֹ מְבַקְשֵׁ֨י פָנֶ֖יךָ יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: zeh dō·wr dō·rə·šō mə·ḇaq·šê p̄ā·ne·ḵā ya·‘ă·qōḇ se·lāh
verses.literal: Such is the generation of those who seek Him who seek Your face O God of Jacob Selah

verses.original: שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים׀ רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וְֽ֭הִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָב֗וֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: śə·’ū šə·‘ā·rîm rā·šê·ḵem wə·hin·nā·śə·’ū piṯ·ḥê ‘ō·w·lām wə·yā·ḇō·w me·leḵ hak·kā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: Lift up your heads O gates Be lifted up O ancient doors that the King of Glory may enter

verses.original: מִ֥י זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַכָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְ֭הוָה עִזּ֣וּז וְגִבּ֑וֹר יְ֝הוָ֗ה גִּבּ֥וֹר מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mî zeh me·leḵ hak·kā·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh ‘iz·zūz wə·ḡib·bō·wr Yah·weh gib·bō·wr mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Who is this King of Glory The LORD strong and mighty the LORD mighty in battle

verses.original: שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים׀ רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וּ֭שְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָבֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: śə·’ū šə·‘ā·rîm rā·šê·ḵem ū·śə·’ū piṯ·ḥê ‘ō·w·lām wə·yā·ḇō me·leḵ hak·kā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: Lift up your heads O gates Be lifted up O ancient doors that the King of Glory may enter

verses.original: מִ֤י ה֣וּא זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַכָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת ה֤וּא מֶ֖לֶךְ הַכָּב֣וֹד סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: mî hū zeh me·leḵ hak·kā·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ hū me·leḵ hak·kā·ḇō·wḏ se·lāh
verses.literal: Who is He this King of Glory The LORD of Hosts He is the King of Glory Selah
